routes.title: Route 1: West loop (Fond du Lac, then Appleton and Capitol near 80th)
routes.when: Tuesday to Thursday, 9:30am to 12:00pm (auto shops, child care and nails are best after the morning rush)

stops.name: Mussomelli's Auto Care
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 9:30-11am. Hours not found anywhere, so call first or just stop by (rule of thumb for auto shops).
points: "I looked you up and the only place I could find you was a BBB listing, with no hours or website. I made a preview so neighbors can find your phone number and address in one tap. Give me your hours and I'll add them."
"A family name on the sign means word of mouth, and a website is how the next person finds the phone number when a friend says 'go to Mussomelli's'."

stops.name: Nuno's Auto Body
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 9:30-11am (it is next door-ish to Mussomelli's; same trip). Hours not found.
points: "Directories list you with just a phone number. A body shop sells how the finish looks, so I built a page with room for before and after photos."
"When someone has a dent they search 'body shop near me' and call the first one that looks real; the preview shows how that would look for Nuno's."

stops.name: Cre8tive Kidz Learning Center
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 9:30-11am, after morning drop-off. Open Mon-Fri 6:30am-7pm per OpenStreetMap, but a directory says Mon-Wed 6am-10pm.
points: "You're in my own ZIP, 53218. Directories list you as licensed for ages 6 weeks to 13 years, but two sources disagree on your hours. A website shows the real ones."
"Parents look for hours and ages first. I put those at the top so they don't have to call during the day."

stops.name: Kids Land Learning Center
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 9:30-11am, after morning drop-off. Open Mon-Fri 6am-9pm per OpenStreetMap and a directory.
stops.phone_note: directories also show (414) 331-9403, ask which is right
points: "I found two different phone numbers for you in directories, (414) 763-3194 and (414) 331-9403. One website would fix that."
"You have a Facebook page, which is great for news. A website puts your hours, licensing and phone in one place parents find on Google."

stops.name: Queen Nails
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 10:00-11:30am before the lunch rush. A directory lists Mon-Sat 8:30am-8pm.
points: "You're on a booking directory with your hours and services, but not under your own name. A site gives you a link of your own to put on Facebook and your card."
"I listed acrylic, gel, dip powder and Russian manicures from what I found. Tell me what's wrong and I'll fix it right now."

routes.title: Route 2: East strip (Appleton and Capitol from 75th Street to 62nd Street)
routes.when: Tuesday to Thursday, 1:30pm to 4:30pm (restaurants are slow between lunch and dinner; Trans-X-Press closes at 5pm)

stops.name: Fiyahside Jamaican Cuisine
stops.best_time: 2:00-4:00pm. Hours not found. This is the second location; the first is on West Villard Avenue.
points: "People find you on Uber Eats and in the news, but when someone wants to call, find the Capitol Drive address and see a menu, there isn't a page of your own."
"I left the menu blank on purpose. A photo of your printed menu is all I need to put it on there."

stops.name: No. 1 Chinese Restaurant
stops.best_time: 2:00-4:00pm. OpenStreetMap lists 11am-9pm (11:30 Sunday), and Tuesday closed. Ask.
points: "For takeout the phone number is everything, so the preview has a big Call button on the first screen and your hours right under it."
"I saw Tuesday listed as closed. If that's wrong, a website is how it stays right in one place."

stops.name: Shawn Da' Barbershop & Beauty Salon
stops.best_time: Tue-Sat 10am-2pm. OpenStreetMap lists Tue-Sat 8am-10pm and Mon/Sun 11am-5pm.
points: "Your Facebook page (Da Real Shawn Da Barber) is the only place I could find you. A website puts your long hours and phone on Google for people who don't look on Facebook."
"You do barber and beauty under one name. The preview lists both so people know they can book either."

stops.name: Trans-X-Press Transmissions
stops.phone_note: directories also show (414) 527-4040, ask which is right
points: "Directories show two phone numbers for you. A website shows the one you want people to call."
"Someone whose transmission is slipping searches in a hurry. They call the shop that shows hours and a phone number in two seconds."

stops.name: Epiphany Beauty Collections
stops.best_time: Tue-Thu 1:30-4pm. Hours not found anywhere, so ask.
stops.phone_note: directories also show (414) 600-1395, ask which is right
points: "You're on Facebook and a booking directory, but I couldn't find hours or a site. People looking for wig installs want to see what you do and where Suite 14 is."
"The preview lists wig installs, keratin treatments, weaves and extensions, the services I found. Tell me what to add or fix."
